purpose: Verify the state_mismatch mitigation for OAuth flows that start on www or other non-apex hosts.

notes: The response headers were received before the client timed out waiting for the redirect response body to close.
The redirect status is 308, so method preservation is expected for clients that follow the redirect.

observations: Playwright/Chromium reached https://archestimator.com/login?next=/workshop after forcing www.archestimator.com to Cloudflare IPv4.
The same headless probe did not finish DOMContentLoaded within the timeout, so the Google button was not used for this specific www-start probe.
Earlier owner Chrome proof already completed real apex Google sign-in and project creation without state_mismatch.
curl -4 to www login returned the Cloudflare 308 redirect on reachable attempts.
A three-attempt IPv4 sample returned two 308 redirects to apex and one SSL connection timeout from this machine.
curl -6 to www login timed out from this machine before connection.
Apex GET probes also showed slow or partial body completion from this environment, so this is tracked as an edge/page response watch item rather than a redirect-rule correctness failure.
Browsers should normally fall back through Happy Eyeballs, but IPv6 and edge reachability should be rechecked from other networks if navigation feels slow.

checks.request: Browser https://archestimator.com/login?next=/workshop then click Continue with Google

rootCause.summary: Better Auth's OAuth state cookie is host-scoped unless cross-subdomain cookies are configured. Starting Google OAuth from www or the Worker subdomain can mint state on that host while Google returns to the apex redirect URI, causing state_mismatch.
rootCause.primaryMitigation: Cloudflare Redirect Rule now canonicalizes www.archestimator.com to archestimator.com before the login or auth-start flow can run.

deploymentNotes: A Worker-level canonical host guard was implemented in source and covered by Vitest, but Cloudflare Worker deploys hung at Wrangler's upload/version endpoints during this run.
The active dashboard redirect rule is the live production mitigation until the Worker code guard is deployed successfully.
remainingRisk: Users already sitting on https://archestimator.com/?error=state_mismatch may need to start a fresh sign-in from /login or /workshop after the old failed callback URL is cleared.
The Worker-subdomain canonical host guard is prepared but not live until Wrangler deploy succeeds.
Cloudflare edge/page response timing is intermittent from this environment and should stay in the performance/reliability QA queue.
Strict public-route performance remains a watch item from the broader post-cutover QA ledger.
